scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Long time no see!
Hey, you didn't quit
your business, did you?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
好久不见！
嘿，你并没有放弃你的事业吧？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Whoa...
You've actually been to Valhalla?! Wow, you've come a long way...
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
哇...
你竟然去过英灵殿？！
天哪，你走了好远的路...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmmm...
It seems that you're not ready to become a Merchant again. Go finish learning the Basic Novice Skills first.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
嗯...
看来你还没准备好重新成为商人。
先去把初心者基础技能学完吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Don't worry, we'll always have a Merchant position open for you. Just come back when you're ready, okay?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
别担心，我们总会为你保留一个商人的职位。
等你准备好了再来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I guess it's destiny that we meet like this once more. Alright. Once again, let me change you into a Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
看来这就是命运让我们再次相遇。
好吧。再一次，让我把你转职为商人吧！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Ah~ How nostalgic. Just like old times! Alright, do your best!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
啊~ 真是怀念。
就像以前一样！
好了，加油吧！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I'm so bored...
When will I hear from my lovely Blossom?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
^333333*叹气*^000000
我好无聊...
我可爱的布洛瑟姆什么时候才会给我写信呢？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hello there!
How do you like
being a Merchant?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
你好！
当商人感觉如何？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Having a way with
money certainly
has its perks,
does it not?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
善于理财确实有不少好处，
不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
We Merchants hate people who are two faced. It's bad for business.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我们商人最讨厌两面三刀的人。
这对生意很不利。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
People who always try to take advantage of other people by selling things at a ridiculous price just so they can make money that they'll waste are the worst.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
那些总是想占别人便宜，以离谱的价格卖东西，只是为了赚点钱然后挥霍掉的人，是最糟糕的。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Well, in any case, we only accept Novices for job changes to the Merchant class. But I appreciate your interest in what we do.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
总之，我们只接受初心者转职为商人。
不过我很感激你对我们工作的兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hello there,
{0}.
Unfortunately, you failed to earn your Merchant License this time.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
你好，
{0}。
很遗憾，你这次没有通过商人执照的考核。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I'll erase your records, so come back anytime when you want to reapply.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我会清除你的记录，
等你想重新申请时随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hello there,
{0}.
I'm pleased to tell you
that I have good news!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
你好，
{0}。
很高兴地告诉你，
我有个好消息！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The Merchant Guild accepted your application. You've proven that you are fully qualified to become a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
商人公会接受了你的申请。
你已经证明了自己完全有资格成为一名商人。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The only thing to take care of is your Membership Fee.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
唯一需要注意的是会费。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Pay the rest of the 500 Zeny
scripts.translation: 支付剩余的500 Zeny

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmmm...
I suppose you currently don't have enough zeny to pay the rest of your Membership fee right now.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
嗯...
看来你现在没有足够的Zeny来支付剩余的会费。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Ah yes...!
Now your
membership
is paid in full.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
啊，是的...！
现在你的
会费
已经缴清了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Please return when you have earned the 500 zeny that you need to become a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
请在你赚到成为商人所需的500 Zeny后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I suppose you need some time to gather some zeny to pay your membership fee. Please come
back as soon as you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我想你需要一些时间来筹集支付会费的Zeny。准备好后请尽快回来。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
恭喜！

scripts.text: I'm very pleased that you are joining the Merchant Guild and hope that you will play an active part in Rune-Midgarts' economy.
scripts.translation: 我很高兴你加入了商人公会，希望你在卢恩·米德加兹的经济中发挥积极作用。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
*Ahem* Aaaaand let me give you a little bit of money for delivering that message to Blossom for me.
I hope you'll help me again next time~
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
*咳* 啊，让我给你一点钱，作为你替我把信送给布洛斯的报酬。
希望下次你还能帮我~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The message you were supposed to deliver as per my request? You've forgotten about that? Oh well. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我让你送的那封信？你忘了？算了。干得好！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Our goal is to control 20 % of the world's income! We're going to need young, eager people like you!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我们的目标是控制世界20%的收入！我们需要像你这样年轻有干劲的人！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But overall, we'll also be happy just to make loads of money.
But we all know that~
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
不过总的来说，只要赚大钱我们就很开心了。
大家都这么想的~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then take it to the former Swordman's Association in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
首先，从仓库领取送货用箱子，然后把它送到普隆德拉的前剑士协会。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then take it to the Mage Guild in Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
首先，从仓库领取送货用箱子，然后把它送到吉芬的魔法师公会。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then take it to Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
首先，从仓库领取送货用箱子，然后把它送到莫罗克那里。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the package from the storehouse, and then give it to the Kafra Employee stationed on Byalan Island. Her name is Blossom.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
首先，从仓库领取箱子，然后把它交给驻守在拜兰岛的卡普拉 职员。她的名字叫布洛斯。

scripts.text: [Chief Mahnsoo]
scripts.translation: [首领 曼苏]

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, give the package to the Kafra Employee stationed near there. Her name is Blossom. Did you get all that?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
到了那里，把箱子交给驻守在那里的卡普拉 职员。她的名字叫布洛斯。都记住了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the Serial Number of the package is ^3355FF2485741^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the Serial Number of the package is ^3355FF2328137^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, give the package to the Mage Guildsman in charge. Remember, the packages Serial Number is ^3355FF2989396^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
到了那里，把箱子交给负责的魔法师公会成员。记住，箱子的序列号是 ^3355FF2989396^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, give the package to the Mage Guildsman in charge. Remember, the packages Serial Number is ^3355FF2191737^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
到了那里，把箱子交给负责的魔法师公会成员。记住，箱子的序列号是 ^3355FF2191737^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
You'll have to find Java Dullihan, the Dyemaker, so that you can deliver the product he ordered.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
你需要找到染布工贾瓦·杜利汉，以便交付他订购的产品。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But he's a little forgetful, so give it to one of his students. Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3012685^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
不过他有点健忘，所以交给他的学生之一吧。记住，箱子的序列号是 ^3355FF3012685^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But he's a little forgetful, give it to one of his students. Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3487372^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
不过他有点健忘，所以交给他的学生之一吧。记住，箱子的序列号是 ^3355FF3487372^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3318702^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3543625^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
Aaaannnnd...
Don't forget to deliver that message for me~
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
还有...
别忘了帮我送那封信哦~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Don't forget your destination and the package's Serial Number.
You'll need to tell them
to the storekeeper.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
记住你的目的地和箱子的序列号。
你需要把它们告诉店主。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The storehouse is in the room
to my right. There, you can talk
to the storekeeper, and he'll
help you out.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
仓库在我右手边的房间里。在那里，你可以和店主交谈，他会帮你的。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
After you make the delivery, return to the storehouse and give the receipt to the storekeeper.
Then, come back
and see me.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
完成配送后，回到仓库把收据交给店主。
然后，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Is that clear?
Alright, that's
the spirit.
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
明白了吗？
很好，就是这样。
加油！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
So, what brings you to
the Merchant Association?
Is there anything
I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
那么，是什么风把你吹到商人协会来了？
有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I want to be a Merchant.
scripts.translation: 我想成为商人。

scripts.text: Tell me about Merchants.
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于商人的事。

scripts.text: Tell me the requirements.
scripts.translation: 告诉我要求。

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Do you want to
be a Merchant?
Well...
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
你想成为商人？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, you have to be a Novice with Job Level 10. Once you do that, make sure you learn all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
首先，你必须是一名职业等级10的初心者。做到这一点后，确保你学会了所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
We're not just
simple money makers!
We pride ourselves on having standards and only accepting qualified applicants!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我们可不是简单的赚钱机器！
我们以拥有标准并只接受合格的申请者而自豪！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Alright, you'll need to fill out this application and prepare 1,000 Zeny for your Membership Fee.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
好的，你需要填写这份申请表，并准备1,000 Zeny作为会员费。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Oh...!
If you don't have all the money,
I can just take 500 Zeny now.
You can pay the rest after you
pass the test and earn your
Merchant Guild License.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
哦...！
如果你没有足够的钱，
我可以先收500 Zeny。
你可以在通过考试并获得商人公会执照后支付剩下的部分。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
So what do you think?
Are you ready to join now?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
那么，你觉得怎么样？
你准备好现在加入了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I will.
scripts.translation: 是的，我愿意。

scripts.text: Ummm, maybe later...
scripts.translation: 嗯，也许以后吧...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Let me check if you
filled out everything
on your application form...
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
让我检查一下
你的申请表
是否都填好了...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmm... 
{0}...
That's a nice name.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
嗯...
{0}...
这个名字不错。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
This application will
only be registered once
the Membership Fee is paid.
How do you wish to
handle the fee?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
只有支付了会员费，
这份申请才会被登记。
你打算如何支付这笔费用？

scripts.text: Pay all 1,000 Zeny now!
scripts.translation: 现在一次性支付1,000 Zeny！

scripts.text: Two payments of 500 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 分两次支付，每次500 Zeny。

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
It seems don't have enough zeny to pay all of the fee right now. Why don't you just pay 500 zeny now? Think about it.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
看来你现在的Zeny不足以支付全部费用。不如先支付500 Zeny？好好考虑一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Alright~
That's 1,000 zeny.
Excellent, excellent.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
好的~
这是1,000 Zeny。
很好，非常好。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmm...
It seems you don't have the funds to pay half of the membership fee. Please come back once you collect the zeny that you need.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
嗯...
看来你没有足够的资金支付一半的会员费。请攒够所需的Zeny后再来。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Let's see...
That's 500 Zeny. Although I don't think splitting payment is a good idea for any Merchant, it's alright since you're still learning.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
让我看看...
这是500 Zeny。虽然我认为对于任何商人来说，分期付款都不是个好主意，但既然你还在学习，那就没关系了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Feel free to return anytime
when you are ready, alright?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
等你准备好了，随时欢迎回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
You don't have enough zeny now? That's no problem. Take your time and come back when you're
ready, okay?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
你现在Zeny不够？没关系。慢慢来，等你准备好了再来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Alright, you're now on the list of applicants. Ah, before I get started let me say just one thing.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
好的，你现在已经在申请人名单上了。啊，在我开始之前，让我先说一件事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
There are some dumb and greedy people out there who do not know what it means to be a Merchant.
I hope you won't turn out to be like them, will you?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
外面有一些愚蠢且贪婪的人，他们根本不知道什么是商人。
我希望你不会变成那样的人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Now, let me
explain what you
need to do for the
Merchant License Test.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
现在，让我
解释一下
你需要为
商人执照考试
做什么。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, then go to the former Swordman's Association in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
首先，从仓库领取送货用箱子，然后前往普隆德拉的前剑士协会。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then go to the Mage Guild in Geffen. When you get there, visit the Mage Guildsman in charge.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
首先，从仓库领取送货用箱子，然后前往吉芬的魔法师公会。到达后，请拜访负责此事的魔法师公会成员。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then go to Morocc. There you must find Java Dullihan, the dyemaker.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
首先，从仓库领取送货用箱子，然后前往莫洛奇。在那里你必须找到染布匠贾瓦·杜里汉。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then give it to the Kafra Employee stationed on Byalan Island.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
首先，从仓库领取送货用箱子，然后将其交给驻扎在拜兰岛的卡普拉 职员。

scripts.text: [Chief Mahnsoo]
scripts.translation: [首领 曼苏]

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, visit the Kafra Employee stationed there. Her name is Blossom. Did you get
all of that?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
到达那里后，请拜访驻扎在那里的卡普拉 职员。她的名字叫布洛瑟姆。你都记住了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
He's a bit forgetful, so you should probably give the package to one of his students.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
他有点健忘，所以你最好把箱子交给他的学生之一。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Ummmm...
And I also have
a bit of a personal
request for you.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
嗯...
另外，我还有一个
私人的小请求。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Would you please give her this message when you deliver the package? Please~
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
送箱子的时候，麻烦你把这个消息也转交给她，好吗？拜托了~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Don't forget your destination and the package's Serial Number. You will need to tell those to the storekeeper in the storehouse to the right of me.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
别忘了目的地和箱子的序列号。你需要把这些告诉右边仓库里的店主。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
After the delivery, give the receipt to the storekeeper, and then come back and see me.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
送货完成后，把收据交给店主，然后回来见我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Is that clear?
Alright, that's
the spirit.
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
明白了吗？
很好，就是这样。
加油！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Merchant?
Well, we basically sell goods to make money. That is the way
of the Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
商人？
嗯，我们基本上就是卖东西赚钱。这就是商人的生存之道。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I guess we may not be the best at fighting, and we don't have many special attacks. We've got no healing skills...
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我想我们可能不太擅长战斗，也没有多少特殊攻击。我们甚至没有治疗技能...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But we can buy goods at lower prices from NPC shops and sell them at a higher price to other people~
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
但是我们可以从NPC商店低价买入货物，然后高价卖给其他人~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Our ultimate attack skill is 'Mammonite.' The strength of Mammonite comes from the anger
when we're forced to throw away perfectly good zeny.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我们最强的攻击技能是“金钱攻击”。金钱攻击的威力来自于当我们被迫扔掉完好无损的Zeny时产生的愤怒。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Throwing away zeny like that
causes a deadly rage to well up in the heart of any Merchant!
Just thinking about it
makes my blood boil!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
像那样扔掉Zeny，会让任何商人的心中涌起致命的怒火！
光是想想就让我热血沸腾！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Anyway, we can use most
weapons except Bows, Rods, and Two-Handed Swords. But we can always sell those.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
总之，除了弓、杖和双手剑，我们几乎可以使用所有武器。不过我们随时可以卖掉那些武器。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Yes...
We Merchants generally
have money on our minds...
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
是的...
我们商人通常
脑子里想的都是钱...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
There are three conditions that must be fulfilled before you can become a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
要成为商人，必须满足三个条件。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, You have to be a Novice with Job Level 10, and have learned all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
第一，你必须是一名职业等级10的初心者，并且已经学会了所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Second, You have to pay a 1,000 Zeny Membership Fee. I believe any Merchant candidate should be able to earn 1,000 Zeny with ease.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
第二，你需要支付1,000 Zeny的会员费。我相信任何想成为商人的候选人都能轻松赚到1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Third, there is a License Test to test your physical strength and sense of direction. You will deliver a package to a specific person in a specific location.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
第三，有一项资格测试，用来测试你的体力和方向感。你需要将一个包裹送到指定地点的特定人物手中。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember...
The package's
Serial Number is
^3355FF{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
记住...
箱子的
序列号是
^3355FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember...
The package's
Serial Number is
^3355FF{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
记住...
箱子的
序列号是
^3355FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Heya pal.
How ya doin'?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿，伙计。
最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey you. We don't have any open positions for part time work. If you wanna earn some zeny, you'll hafta look elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿，你。我们没有兼职的空缺职位。如果你想赚点Zeny，得去别处找找。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey you. Yeah, you.
If you wanna restart the test, go visit Mahnsoo in the other room. Then we can talk.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿，你。对，就是你。
如果你想重新参加测试，去隔壁房间找曼苏。然后我们再谈。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Alright! Everything looks perfect! I'll report your success to the guildmaster. Now go talk to Chief Mahnsoo, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
很好！一切看起来都很完美！我会向公会会长报告你的成功。现在去找首领 曼苏吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
Oh, yeah? Okay, lemme check. Your name is {0}? Alright, your destination was...
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
哦，是吗？好的，让我查一下。你的名字是{0}？嗯，你的目的地是...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Wow! You met the Kafra babe in Prontera?! Lucky you~ ...Receipt?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
哇！你在普隆德拉遇到了卡普拉的宝贝？真幸运~ ...收据呢？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Geffen Magic Academy. Okay, receipt?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
吉芬魔法学院。好的，收据呢？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
The dyemaker in Morocc. Not bad. Receipt?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
摩洛克城的染坊。不错嘛。收据呢？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Oh hohohoho~! The Kafra Babe on Byalan Island?! Awesome! Anyway, did you bring the receipt?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
哦呵呵呵~！拜兰岛的卡普拉宝贝？太棒了！话说回来，你带收据了吗？

scripts.text: [Union Staff Kay]
scripts.translation: [联盟职员 凯]

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
Wait a sec.
Where's the receipt?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
等一下。
收据在哪里？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
If you don't have the receipt, you fail the test! You better talk to Mahnsoo if you wanna retake it, alright? Pay attention next time!
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
如果没有收据，测试就失败了！如果你想重考，最好去找曼苏，好吗？下次要注意了！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
...Great! Everything's perfect! I'll report your success to the Guildmaster. You should talk to Chief Mahnsoo now, alright?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
...太好了！一切都很完美！我会向公会会长报告你的成功。现在去找首领 曼苏吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
Huh?
You're back?
So how did
the delivery go?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
咦？
你回来了？
那么送货
进行得怎么样？

scripts.text: *Sob* I lost the package.
scripts.translation: *抽泣* 我把包裹弄丢了。

scripts.text: Fine.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Are you kidding me? You'll fail the test if you lose the package!
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
你在开玩笑吗？弄丢包裹测试就失败了！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Awwww man. Well, if you wanna restart the test, talk to Mahnsoo, okay? You're lucky you're getting another chance!
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
哎呀。好吧，如果你想重新开始测试，去找曼苏，好吗？你能再得到一次机会，真是幸运！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Huh...
Okay...
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嗯...
好吧...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey, what are you still doing here? Shouldn't you be on your way already?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿，你怎么还在这里？你不该已经出发了吗？

scripts.text: I need a new package.
scripts.translation: 我需要一个新的包裹。

scripts.text: Oh, yeah. You're right!
scripts.translation: 哦，对。你说得对！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Wha--?
So where did
the package go?
Where is it?!
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
什--么？
那么包裹
去哪里了？
它在哪里？！

scripts.text: *Sob* I lost it!
scripts.translation: *抽泣* 我弄丢了！

scripts.text: I have it right here.
scripts.translation: 我这就在这里。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
You...
Lost it?!
You failed the test!
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
你...
弄丢了？！
你考试不及格！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
*Sigh* If you want to restart the test, go visit Mahnsoo in the other room, alright?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
*叹气* 如果你想重新考试，去隔壁房间找曼苏首领，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Huh.
I thought
you lost it.
You don't
need a new one.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
哈。
我还以为
你弄丢了。
你不需要
新的了。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
*Sigh* Man, you're starting to become a pain in the ass. Hold on, lemme cancel your record...
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
*叹气* 真是的，你越来越让人头疼了。稍等，让我取消你的记录...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
I need some time to get everything in order, so come back later.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
我需要一些时间来整理一切，请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
What a bummer...
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
真扫兴...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey there.
what brings
you here?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿。
你找我有
什么事？

scripts.text: My Merchant License test.
scripts.translation: 我的商人执照考试。

scripts.text: I'm looking for part time work.
scripts.translation: 我在找兼职工作。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
I see.
Alright.
So what's
your name?
{0}...?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
明白了。
好的。
那么你的
名字是？
{0}...？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Huh. Your name's not on my list. Did you apply for the job change quest or what?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
哈。我的名单上没有你的名字。你是来申请更换职业任务的吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
You gotta apply first by talking to Chief Mahnsoo in the center
of this building, okay?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
你得先找这栋楼中央的曼苏首领申请，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Alright, there you go. Lemme give you the package. Now, choose the destination of the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
好的，给你。让我把包裹给你。现在，请选择送货目的地。

scripts.text: Prontera.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Geffen.
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Morocc.
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇

scripts.text: Byalan Island.
scripts.translation: 拜兰岛

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Okay, now you need to give me the package's Serial Number. If you wanna cancel, just enter '0', alright?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
好的，现在你需要给我包裹的序列号。如果你想取消，输入“0”即可，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Are you sure that you wanna cancel?
Alright, we'll cancel for now.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
你确定要取消吗？
好的，我们暂时取消。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Are you sure that you wanna cancel?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
你确定要取消吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Let me try again.
scripts.translation: 让我再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey hey. That number's not valid! Enter a value from 1000000 to 5000000. got it?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿，嘿。那个号码无效！请输入1000000到5000000之间的数值，明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Destination is Prontera. The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
目的地是普隆德拉。序列号是{0}。您确定吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Destination is Geffen. Phew! That's really far! The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
目的地是吉芬。哎呀！那真的很远！序列号是{0}。您确定吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Destination is Morocc. That's pretty far away! The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
目的地是莫洛奇。那也挺远的！序列号是{0}。您确定吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Lucky you! Your destination is Byalan Island. The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
真幸运！您的目的地是拜兰岛。序列号是{0}。您确定吗？

scripts.text: Positive.
scripts.translation: 确定。

scripts.text: Whoops! Wrong number!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！号码错了！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Alright. Take this package and guard it with your life until it's safely delivered to the customer. Don't lose this thing, got it?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
好的。拿着这个包裹，用生命守护它，直到安全送达顾客手中。别弄丢了，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Well then, I wish you luck. Remember, you gotta bring me
a receipt once you finish the delivery, okay?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
那么，祝你好运。记住，完成配送后一定要把收据带回来给我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Part time job? Sorry pal, no jobs yet. The Paymaster's department can never balance our budget...
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
兼职工作？抱歉，朋友，目前还没有工作机会。财务部门总是无法平衡我们的预算...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Nothing, eh?
I guess you enjoy
bothering people for
no reason then, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
没什么事吗？
看来您很喜欢
无缘无故地
打扰别人呢，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
You're from
the Merchant Guild?
Yes! You've come to
the right place.
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
您是来自
商会的吗？
是的！您来对地方了。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
But...
Where's the
package I ordered?
That's strange...
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
但是...
我订购的包裹
在哪里？
这很奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Okay~
Please set the
package down
over there.
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
好的~
请把包裹
放在那边。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Let me check the Serial Number of the package so I can give you the receipt, okay?
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
让我检查一下包裹的序列号，这样我才能给您收据，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Excuse me, but...
I don't think this is the package we ordered. The Serial Number should be 3012685. See?
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
抱歉，但是...
我觉得这不是我们订购的包裹。序列号应该是3012685。您看？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Excuse me, but...
I don't think this is the package we ordered. The Serial Number should be 3487372. See?
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
抱歉，但是...
我觉得这不是我们订购的包裹。序列号应该是3487372。您看？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Excuse me, but...
I don't think this is the package we ordered. The Serial Number should be 3012685 or 3487372. Well, one of those two...
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
抱歉，但是...
我觉得这不是我们订购的包裹。序列号应该是3012685或3487372。嗯，其中两个之一...

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
3012685...
That's right.
Here's your
receipt.
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
3012685...
没错。
这是您的
收据。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
3487372...
That's right.
Here's your
receipt.
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
3487372...
没错。
这是您的
收据。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Thanks a lot!
See you again
sometime!
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
非常感谢！
期待下次
再会！

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Oh...
You're gonna
go back? Okay
then, take care!
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
啊...
您要回去了吗？
那好吧，保重！

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Mr. Java Dullihan is the one and only, the best dye maker on the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
贾瓦·杜利汉先生是米德加尔特大陆上独一无二、最出色的染料制造者。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Aaaand I'm proud to say that I'm his student! Someday, I'll be able to make really beautiful dyes too!
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
而且我很自豪地说，我是他的学徒！总有一天，我也能做出非常漂亮的染料！

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Of course, I'm still learning the basics right now, but someday...
scripts.translation:
[染色师的学徒]
当然，我现在还在学习基础，但是总有一天...

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Ah, you must be with the Merchant Guild. Finally, my package has arrived! Alright...!
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
啊，您一定是商人公会的吧。终于，我的包裹到了！好的...

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Wait...
Where's the
package?
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
等等...
包裹在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
You must be very tired
from having to travel
in this kind
of weather...
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
在这种天气下奔波，
您一定很累了...

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Alright, let me
check the Serial Number...
Uh oh, this is the wrong number. This isn't what we ordered...
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
好的，让我
检查一下序列号...
哎呀，这个号码不对。这不是我们订购的...

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Alright, let me
check the Serial Number...
2989396. Yes, this is what we ordered. Here is your receipt.
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
好的，让我
检查一下序列号...
2989396。是的，这是我们订购的。这是您的收据。

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Alright, let me
check the Serial Number...
2191737. Yes, this is what we ordered. Here is your receipt.
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
好的，让我
检查一下序列号...
2191737。是的，这是我们订购的。这是您的收据。

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
The Serial Number
should be 2989396.
Look here!
Don't you see
something
is wrong?
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
序列号
应该是2989396。
您看这里！
您没发现
有什么
不对劲吗？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
The Serial Number
should be 2191737.
Look here!
Don't you see
something
is wrong?
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
序列号
应该是2191737。
您看这里！
您没发现
有什么
不对劲吗？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
The Serial Number
should be 2989396
or 2191737, one of
those two.
Look here!
Don't you see
something
is wrong?
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
序列号
应该是2989396
或2191737，
其中两个之一。
您看这里！
您没发现
有什么
不对劲吗？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Heh heh~
Thank you!
Bye bye!
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
呵呵~
谢谢！
再见！

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Hello,
Merchant Guildsman~
I give you my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
你好，
商人公会成员~
非常感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
My package should have arrived by now. Huh. I guess the Merchant Guild might be running a little late...
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
我的包裹应该已经送到了。嗯。看来商人公会可能稍微有点迟到...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh! Thank you for
traveling such a long
way to come over here~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
哦！感谢您
长途跋涉来到这里~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
A delivery from
the Merchant Guild?
Oh, yes, please set
it down right over there...
W-wait. Didn't you bring it?
Where's the package?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
来自商人公会的
快递？
哦，好的，请把它
放在那边...
等等。您没带过来吗？
包裹在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
A delivery from
the Merchant Guild?
Oh, yes, please set
it down right over there...
You must be really tired
after carrying it for so long!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
来自商人公会的
快递？
哦，好的，请把它
放在那边...
您搬运了这么久，
一定很累吧！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Now, let me check
the serial number...
2485741. Right, this is
the one we ordered. Oh,
